epic.name: Hybrid CLI Routing Implementation
epic.description: Implement hybrid routing architecture with Claude Max coordinators and z.ai workers for 97% cost savings
deliverables: Updated CFN Loop instructions with hybrid patterns
Coordinator agent profiles with orchestration logic
Worker agent profiles with Redis communication
Swarm execution script with provider detection

phases.name: Security Hardening (CRITICAL)
phases.description: Implement Redis security fixes before enabling hybrid routing in production

sprints.name: Redis Authentication
sprints.description: Implement password-based authentication for all Redis connections

tasks.name: Configure Redis server authentication
tasks.description: Set requirepass in redis.conf, generate secure password, restart Redis server

tasks.name: Update Redis client connections
tasks.description: Add authentication to all Redis clients in codebase (coordinator, workers, tests)

tasks.name: Test authentication failures
tasks.description: Verify unauthorized connections are rejected, test password rotation

sprints.name: JSON Schema Validation
sprints.description: Validate all Redis pub/sub messages to prevent injection attacks

tasks.name: Define message schemas
tasks.description: Create JSON schemas for worker completion events, coordinator commands, validation messages

tasks.name: Implement schema validator
tasks.description: Create validator class using ajv library, validate all incoming Redis messages

tasks.name: Integrate validation in Redis clients
tasks.description: Add validation to pub/sub handlers, reject invalid messages, log security events

tasks.name: Test malformed payloads
tasks.description: Test injection attempts, malformed JSON, schema violations, verify rejection

sprints.name: HMAC-SHA256 Message Signing
sprints.description: Sign all worker completion events to prevent message spoofing

tasks.name: Implement message signer
tasks.description: Create HMAC-SHA256 signer using crypto library, sign all outgoing messages

tasks.name: Verify signatures in coordinator
tasks.description: Add signature verification to coordinator, reject unsigned/invalid messages

tasks.name: Test signature tampering
tasks.description: Test modified signatures, replayed messages, verify rejection

successCriteria.verification: All security tests passing, Redis authenticated, messages validated and signed

successCriteria.criterion: Hybrid routing enabled by default with Claude Max
successCriteria.verification: /switch-api max sets hybridRouting.enabled = true in settings.json

successCriteria.criterion: Coordinators use Claude Max subscription ($0 cost)
successCriteria.verification: Cost tracking shows $0 for coordinator execution

successCriteria.criterion: Workers use z.ai provider (97% cost savings)
successCriteria.verification: Cost tracking shows $0.10-2/1M tokens for workers
Coordinator provides structured updates vs. raw CLI output baseline
Coordinator detects failures, relaunches workers, reports resolution
All documentation updated with hybrid patterns and examples
5+ production CFN Loop executions complete without major issues

risks.risk: Security fixes incomplete before production use
risks.mitigation: Phase 0 blocks all subsequent phases, must complete security before enabling hybrid routing

risks.risk: Coordinator spawning fails on subscription accounts
risks.mitigation: Test with actual Claude Max subscription account in phase 4 testing

risks.risk: Worker profiles not updated causing Redis communication failures
risks.mitigation: Create reusable template in sprint 1.2, batch update common profiles
Dedicated validation test in sprint 4.2, compare to z.ai billing dashboard

risks.risk: User confusion about when hybrid routing is active
risks.mitigation: Clear status messages in /switch-api, documentation with examples

steps: Disable hybrid routing: Edit ~/.claude/settings.json, set hybridRouting.enabled = false
Revert to pure provider mode: All agents use main provider
Alternative: Switch to pure z.ai: /switch-api zai for full cost savings without coordinator
Investigate issues: Review logs, coordinator behavior, worker completion events
Fix and retest: Address issues in development, rerun phase 4 testing
Gradual re-enable: Test with single user, expand to team if successful
